newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas still strong in winter but trade thin.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas still strong in winter but trade thin.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures slowed down on Friday morning after the record volume day on Thursday, but the trend was still stronger.
The only deal done was in December, where 25 lots traded at 15.65 pence a therm, up by 0.05 pence from Thursday's settlement and a new contract high.

January and February, which had seen large volumes on Thursday, were both offered at 18.725 pence a therm by the close against a previous settlement level of 18.70 pence. The whole of Q1 98 was bid at 17.08 pence and offered at 17.26 pence by the close of the morning session.
Front month September was bid at 9.45 pence against an offer at 9.75 pence at the close.
